caveat: concat_mode measures detector behaviour on MULTI-AUTHOR pseudo-documents built by concatenating short same-band essays until each has MIN_PARAGRAPHS eligible paragraphs. Every pseudo-doc contains genuine author boundaries, so these flag rates are an UPPER BOUND on style-break flagging, NOT the rate a real single-author ESL essay would see. The load-bearing quantity is the lower-minus-higher GAP under identical construction, read alongside mean_essays_per_pseudo_doc (a band packing more source essays per pseudo-doc has more author boundaries — a confound correlated with, but not identical to, prose style). Construction is deterministic (fixed-seed shuffle); seed_robustness shows the gap is not a shuffle artifact.
